title: Earlier pull-request checks
tagline: Catch a bad description before the pull request exists
intro: The early check on pull-request descriptions now reads one more kind of command.

steps.say: When the description is missing its work-order line or its closing line, the command is stopped before the pull request exists.
do:
try $'cat > b.md <<EOF
Just a summary.
EOF
gh pr create --title t --body-file b.md'

steps.say: When the description has both lines, the command goes through untouched.
do:
try $'cat > b.md <<EOF
No work order: a demo.
Closes #1
EOF
gh pr create --title t --body-file b.md'

outro: Now it fails in seconds, with the same two reasons the build would give.
